active_dtcs.title: Oxygen (O2) Lambda Sensor Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1)
active_dtcs.title_gu: ઓક્સિજન (O2) લેમ્બડા સેન્સર સર્કિટ ફોલ્ટ
active_dtcs.symptom: Drop in fuel mileage (3-5 km/l loss), sluggish throttle response, black sooty spark plug.
active_dtcs.root_cause: Carbon buildup on lambda zirconium sensor tip causing delayed voltage switching (<0.2V to >0.8V).

active_dtcs.mechanic_notes: Master Tech Ramesh: Apply high-temperature anti-seize copper grease to O2 sensor threads; torque to 25 Nm.

diagnosis_en: Master Tech Ramesh: Erratic cold idle caused by carbon accumulation on Stepper Motor bypass orifice (DTC P0505). Throttle body ultrasonic flush recommended.
